title: Density of Symmetric Primes
exact_target: Does the number of primes below x that have a symmetric-prime partner have the proposed logarithmic exponent?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1874 (GUY-A20). CC BY 4.0.
William Banks, Paul Pollack and Carl Pomerance, \emph{Symmetric primes revisited}, arXiv:1908.06161v2 (2019), §1, Theorems 1.1--1.2 and the density conjecture following them.
